project_type: Next.js 16.4.2 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode
build_system: Turbopack (next dev / next build). next.config.ts has turbopack.rules for CSS via @tailwindcss/turbopack. No webpack config. cacheComponents and partialPrefetching are enabled experimental flags.
test_framework: None — verify with `next build` (must produce 0 errors) and manual browser check
verification_instructions: Run `npx next build` in d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork. Build must complete with exit 0 and no TypeScript or hydration errors. Check the output for the /showcase route being emitted.
snapshot_or_generated_files: .next/types/app/showcase/page.d.ts is auto-generated by next dev/build — do not create it manually. Run `npx next build` to regenerate.
environment_constraints: Windows paths with spaces. All shell commands must quote paths. Do NOT restart or kill any dev server. Shell is cmd. Use npx prefix for next commands.
contribution_requirements: Never modify app/page.tsx or app/layout.tsx. Tailwind v4: no tailwind.config.js — use @theme blocks in globals.css for new CSS variables. Dynamic colors use inline style={{color:'#hex'}}. images.qualities must be set in next.config.ts for any quality prop used.
key_patterns: 1) 'use client' at top of every file using hooks/framer-motion/three.js. 2) next/dynamic with ssr:false for all Three.js Canvas components. 3) Metadata exported from Server Component page.tsx only. 4) next/image: use preload={true} instead of priority (deprecated in v16). 5) blurDataURL='data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==' for all dynamic images. 6) Image paths with spaces must be passed as-is to next/image (Next handles encoding); for useTexture pass encodeURIComponent on each path segment (not the slash). 7) @/* maps to workspace root (not src/). 8) LayoutProps<'/'> is globally available — no import. 9) Three.js: frameloop='demand' + IntersectionObserver to pause off-screen. 10) Framer Motion: no AnimatePresence in Server Components — wrap in a client component.
directory_structure: app/ — App Router pages and layouts. app/showcase/ — new route (create page.tsx here). components/showcase/ — all new UI components (already empty dir exists). data/ — does NOT exist yet; create data/showcase.ts. public/ — all images and PDFs (already listed). .agents/tasks/ — plan and FEAT files.
